library(Seurat)

save_plot = function(plot, file, legend = TRUE, width = 5, height = 4, png = FALSE) {

}

# Load Tabula Sapiens data.
```{r}
adipose = readRDS("../10x_Flex/input_data/tabula_sapiens/tabula_adipose_tissue_symbols.rds")
bone_marrow = readRDS("../10x_Flex/input_data/tabula_sapiens/tabula_bone_marrow_symbols.rds")
kidney = readRDS("../10x_Flex/input_data/tabula_sapiens/tabula_kidney_symbols.rds")
liver = readRDS("../10x_Flex/input_data/tabula_sapiens/tabula_liver_symbols.rds")
lung = readRDS("../10x_Flex/input_data/tabula_sapiens/tabula_lung_symbols.rds")
lymph_node = readRDS("../10x_Flex/input_data/tabula_sapiens/tabula_lymph_node_symbols.rds")
skin = readRDS("../10x_Flex/input_data/tabula_sapiens/tabula_skin_symbols.rds")
spleen = readRDS("../10x_Flex/input_data/tabula_sapiens/tabula_spleen_symbols.rds")

```


```{r}
suspected_epcs = readRDS("rds_objects/epcs/epcs.rds")
DefaultAssay(suspected_epcs) = "RNA"
suspected_epcs[["SCT"]] = NULL
suspected_epcs$cell_type = "HSC-differentiated EPC"
suspected_epcs$label = "HSC-differentiated EPC"
```

```{r}
set.seed(1234)
NUM_TO_SAMPLE = 1233
prep_for_clustering = function(tissue_data, cell_type_of_interest, label) {
  cell_type_data = subset(tissue_data, subset = cell_type == cell_type_of_interest)
  cell_type_data = subset(cell_type_data, cells = sample(Cells(cell_type_data), NUM_TO_SAMPLE))
  cell_type_data$label = label
  return(cell_type_data)
}

adipose_msc = prep_for_clustering(adipose, "mesenchymal stem cell", "adipose: mesenchymal stem cell")
bone_marrow_monocyte = prep_for_clustering(bone_marrow, "monocyte", "bone marrow: monocyte")
kidney_epithelial = prep_for_clustering(kidney, "kidney epithelial cell", "kidney: epithelial cell")
liver_hepatocyte = prep_for_clustering(liver, "hepatocyte", "liver: hepatocyte")
lung_basal_cell = prep_for_clustering(lung, "basal cell", "lung: basal cell")
lymph_node_b_cell = prep_for_clustering(lymph_node, "naive B cell", "lymph node: B cell")
skin_endothelial = prep_for_clustering(skin, "endothelial cell", "skin: endothelial cell")
spleen_nk = prep_for_clustering(spleen, "mature NK T cell", "spleen: NK cell")

```

```{r}
single_cell_for_bulking = merge(suspected_epcs, c(adipose_msc, bone_marrow_monocyte, kidney_epithelial, liver_hepatocyte, lung_basal_cell, lymph_node_b_cell, skin_endothelial, spleen_nk))
```

```{r}
sce = SingleCellExperiment(single_cell_for_bulking@assays$RNA@counts, colData = single_cell_for_bulking@meta.data)
assayNames(sce) = "counts"
agg_data = aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = colData(sce)[,c("label")])
agg_sce = logNormCounts(agg_data)
agg_seu = as.Seurat(agg_sce)
```

```{r}
collapsed_counts = agg_seu@assays$originalexp@counts %>% as.data.frame()
```


# Load published EPC data.
```{r}
epc_raw = read_tsv("input_data/published_epcs/GSE197907_raw_counts_GRCh38.p13_NCBI.tsv")
```

```{r}
epc_ids = epc_raw$GeneID

ensembl = useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
gene_info = getBM(attributes = c("entrezgene_id", "hgnc_symbol"),
                   filters = "entrezgene_id",
                   values = epc_ids,
                   mart = ensembl)
epc_raw = left_join(epc_raw, gene_info, by = c(GeneID = "entrezgene_id"))
epc_clean = epc_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(hgnc_symbol))
```

```{r}
collapsed_counts = collapsed_counts %>%
  rownames_to_column("hgnc_symbol")

epc_and_comparison = inner_join(epc_clean, collapsed_counts) %>%
  dplyr::select(-GeneID)
epc_and_comparison$hgnc_symbol = make.unique(epc_and_comparison$hgnc_symbol)
epc_and_comparison = epc_and_comparison %>%
  column_to_rownames("hgnc_symbol")
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)
gene_expression_scaled = t(scale(t(epc_and_comparison)))

# Calculate the variance for each feature
variances = apply(gene_expression_scaled, 1, var)

# Sort the features by variance
sorted_variances = sort(variances, decreasing = TRUE)

# Select the top 20 variable features
top_20_features = names(sorted_variances)[1:20]

# Subset the data frame to include only the top 20 variable features
top_20_df = gene_expression_scaled[top_20_features, ]
colnames(top_20_df)[c(1:12)] = paste("EPC", c(1:12))

phtmap = pheatmap(top_20_df, 
         clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean", 
         clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean", 
         clustering_method = "complete", 
         show_rownames = FALSE, 
         show_colnames = TRUE)

```

```{r}
svg("figures/dendrograms/epc_dendrogram.svg", height = 6, width = 6)
par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 18) + 0.1) # Increase the right margin
(dendrogram = phtmap[[2]] %>%
 as.dendrogram() %>%
 plot(horiz=TRUE))
dev.off()
```


```{r}
write_tsv(top_20_df %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("gene"), "tables/epc/compare_to_published_epcs.tsv")
```
